zh.title: 工单刚转交，AI 的回答却变成“已发货”：新消息该算哪一轮？
zh.summary: 同一刻，工具返回“工单已转交”，用户追问订单。AG2 的修复前后局部对照显示：若本轮多调用一次模型，交接结果会被订单回答取代。我们又对照 CodeFlowMu 的输入投递边界。

en.title: The ticket was escalated. Why did the AI answer about shipping?
en.summary: A tool says the ticket was escalated just as the user asks about an order. In a bounded AG2 before/after comparison, one extra model call replaces the handoff result with a shipping answer. We compare that turn boundary with CodeFlowMu
